summary: Defined the Agent Runtime observation fabric and operator event intake boundary so kernel, runtime, service, audit, operator, ecosystem, external and model-origin signals can inform replanning without becoming direct action authority.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-observation-fabric.md defines source classes for kernel, runtime, service, audit, operator, ecosystem, external, model and sanitized-summary observations.
External observations are defined as external-untrusted and can only become sanitized replanning hints with direct_tool_call_allowed=false.
Operator events enter through explicit CLI/TUI/API surfaces and preserve actor, surface, requested outcome, working scope, trust boundary and sequence reference.
Source-to-sink checks are required before observation-derived text can influence write, execute, privileged, secret or exfiltration sinks.
Observation references include observation_id, step_id, trust_label and observation_hash so durable state and projections can link observations without treating raw text as authority.

commands.summary: 7 passed; external content is untrusted, observation text cannot create direct tool calls, secret-like tool output is redacted and observation refs persist with hashes.
19 passed; prompt injection, resource abuse, secret handling, package install isolation and denied side-effect paths remain covered.

blocked_shortcuts: No external observation is treated as operator intent.
No model or observation text can directly create tool calls, approvals, capability leases or policy overrides.
No denied observation-derived action may emit EffectPrepared.
promotion_impact: Completes the observation intake contract needed before scheduler budgets, durable runtime state and ecosystem activation can safely consume runtime signals.
